scope.scope_note: Pinned entry files only; referenced guides and examples are not recursively fetched. Non-Latin tokenization is exploratory.

methods.combined: 0.7 word unigram/bigram TF-IDF cosine + 0.3 character 3-5gram TF-IDF cosine
methods.clustering: Average-linkage agglomerative clustering; k=2..12 selected by cosine-distance silhouette
methods.perturbation: 80% retained prose lines without replacement; fixed fitted vocabulary and IDF
methods.distillation: Greedy coverage of repository-balanced TF-IDF vocabulary appearing in 3+ repositories, per paragraph word-count^0.65; extraction locator only, not a quality ranking
methods.projection: Metric MDS of combined distance; 2D placement is approximate; inspect exact neighbor scores
methods.phrase_null: 100 token-order permutations per selected high-overlap pair; exploratory, no hypothesis-test claims
methods.scope_caveat: Textual similarity does not establish agreement, truth, effectiveness or authorial provenance.
